checks: Real local POS loads without any retail writes
Single authorized warehouse is selected automatically and selector hidden
POS barcode, stock filters, quantity controls, serial/lot fields, shortcuts and exact-payment helper work
POS product grid and checkout render at 390px without root overflow
Ambiguous create freezes inputs and replays the same key/payload
Unit conversion preview is scaled; draft total and line amounts replace estimated prices with server values
POS draft review -> submit uses server total, debt 50,000, and selected customer
POS history opens an existing receipt while the new cart remains available
Preorder deliberately converts cart to order without posting stock; approval cancellation is disabled
Zero stock warns before draft creation and disables POS checkout
Stock changes after draft are detected before submit; explicit cancellation preserves cart for preorder without payment
Sales lists are filtered on server by document type and display empty state
Mobile 390px sales workspace has no root horizontal overflow
